f3_program: collection("garden.bugs", "bug", "garden", source("the garden has 400 bugs to start"))
collection("garden.spiders", "spider", "garden", source("introduces 12 spiders"))
observe(at("garden.bugs.count", "initial"), 400, "count", source("the garden has 400 bugs to start"))
observe(at("garden.spiders.each.bugs_eaten.count", "current"), 7, "count", source("Each spider he introduces eats 7 bugs"))
observe(at("bill.garden_sprays.count", "current"), 1, "count", source("Bill sprays once"))

remove("spray_once", "bill", at("garden.bugs.count", "current"), "garden.bugs.removed_by_spray.count", source("each time he sprays the garden he reduces the total bug population to 80% of what it was previously"))
percent_of(at("garden.bugs.count", "current"), at("garden.bugs.count", "initial"), 80, source("reduces the total bug population to 80% of what it was previously"))
add("introduce_spiders", "bill", at("garden.spiders.count", "current"), 12, source("introduces 12 spiders"))

product_relation(at("garden.bugs.eaten_by_introduced_spiders.count", "current"), event_field("introduce_spiders", "quantity"), at("garden.spiders.each.bugs_eaten.count", "current"), source("Each spider he introduces eats 7 bugs"))

consume("introduced_spiders_eat", "garden.spiders", at("garden.bugs.count", "current"), at("garden.bugs.eaten_by_introduced_spiders.count", "current"), source("Each spider he introduces eats 7 bugs"))
query("remaining_count", "garden.bugs", "current")
collection("downtown.buildings", "building", "downtown", source("three buildings downtown"))
observe(at("downtown.buildings.count", "current"), 3, "count", source("three buildings downtown"))
collection("downtown.building_heights", "height", "downtown", source("estimate their heights"))
member("downtown.building_heights", "downtown.building_heights.middle", source("the one in the middle is 100 feet tall"))
member("downtown.building_heights", "downtown.building_heights.left", source("The one on the left looks like it is 80% of the height of the middle one"))
member("downtown.building_heights", "downtown.building_heights.right", source("The one on the right looks 20 feet shorter"))
observe(at("downtown.building_heights.middle", "current"), 100, "foot", source("the one in the middle is 100 feet tall"))
percent_of(at("downtown.building_heights.left", "current"), at("downtown.building_heights.middle", "current"), 80, source("The one on the left looks like it is 80% of the height of the middle one"))

sum_relation(at("downtown.left_middle_stacked_height", "current"), at("downtown.building_heights.left", "current"), at("downtown.building_heights.middle", "current"), source("the building on the left and middle were stacked on top of each other"))

offset(at("downtown.building_heights.right", "current"), at("downtown.left_middle_stacked_height", "current"), -20, "foot", source("The one on the right looks 20 feet shorter than if the building on the left and middle were stacked on top of each other"))
query("sum", "downtown.building_heights", "current")
collection("water_case.bottles", "bottle", "water_case", source("A case of water contains 24 bottles"))
observe(at("water_case.bottles.count", "current"), 24, "count", source("A case of water contains 24 bottles"))
collection("camp.groups", "group", "camp", source("A children's camp comprising of 4 groups"))
observe(at("camp.groups.count", "current"), 4, "count", source("comprising of 4 groups"))
collection("camp.water_cases", "case", "camp", source("purchased 13 cases"))
add("water_case_purchase", "camp", at("camp.water_cases.count", "current"), 13, source("purchased 13 cases"))
observe(at("camp.duration", "current"), 3, "day", source("a 3-day camp"))
observe(at("camp.groups.first.children.count", "current"), 14, "count", source("The first group has 14 children"))
observe(at("camp.groups.second.children.count", "current"), 16, "count", source("the second group has 16 children"))
observe(at("camp.groups.third.children.count", "current"), 12, "count", source("the third group has 12 children"))

sum_relation(at("camp.groups.first_three.children.count", "current"), at("camp.groups.first.children.count", "current"), at("camp.groups.second.children.count", "current"), at("camp.groups.third.children.count", "current"), source("the number of the first three groups combined"))

fraction_of(at("camp.groups.fourth.children.count", "current"), at("camp.groups.first_three.children.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("the fourth group has half of the number of the first three groups combined"))

sum_relation(at("camp.children.count", "current"), at("camp.groups.first.children.count", "current"), at("camp.groups.second.children.count", "current"), at("camp.groups.third.children.count", "current"), at("camp.groups.fourth.children.count", "current"), source("The first group has 14 children, the second group has 16 children, the third group has 12 children, and the fourth group has half of the number of the first three groups combined"))
observe(at("camp.child.water_bottles.consumed.count", "per_day"), 3, "count", source("each child consumes 3 bottles a day"))

product_relation(at("camp.water_bottles.available.count", "current"), event_field("water_case_purchase", "quantity"), at("water_case.bottles.count", "current"), source("A case of water contains 24 bottles. A children's camp comprising of 4 groups purchased 13 cases"))

product_relation(at("camp.water_bottles.required.count", "current"), at("camp.children.count", "current"), at("camp.child.water_bottles.consumed.count", "per_day"), at("camp.duration", "current"), source("each child consumes 3 bottles a day"))
query("difference", at("camp.water_bottles.available.count", "current"), at("camp.water_bottles.required.count", "current"))
observe(at("jenny.board_game_friends.count", "current"), 2, "count", source("her two friends"))

member("jenny.board_game_wins.by_friend", "jenny.board_game_wins.by_friend.jill", source("playing Jill"))

difference_relation(at("jenny.board_game_wins.by_friend.jill", "current"), at("jenny.board_games.with_jill.count", "current"), at("jill.board_game_wins.against_jenny.count", "current"), source("she's played her twice as many times as she's played Mark and Jill has won 75% of them"))

percent_of(at("haleigh.old_candles.one_ounce.each.wax", "remaining"), at("haleigh.old_candles.one_ounce.each.wax", "original"), 10, source("Each candle has 10% of it's original wax left"))

product_relation(at("haleigh.old_candles.twenty_ounce.wax", "remaining"), at("haleigh.old_candles.twenty_ounce.count", "current"), at("haleigh.old_candles.twenty_ounce.each.wax", "remaining"), source("five 20 oz candles"))

product_relation(at("haleigh.old_candles.five_ounce.wax", "remaining"), at("haleigh.old_candles.five_ounce.count", "current"), at("haleigh.old_candles.five_ounce.each.wax", "remaining"), source("5 five ounce candles"))

product_relation(at("haleigh.old_candles.one_ounce.wax", "remaining"), at("haleigh.old_candles.one_ounce.count", "current"), at("haleigh.old_candles.one_ounce.each.wax", "remaining"), source("twenty-five one ounce candles"))

sum_relation(at("haleigh.combined_wax", "current"), at("haleigh.old_candles.twenty_ounce.wax", "remaining"), at("haleigh.old_candles.five_ounce.wax", "remaining"), at("haleigh.old_candles.one_ounce.wax", "remaining"), source("last bit of wax combined together"))
observe(at("haleigh.new_candles.each.wax", "target"), 5, "ounce", source("5 ounce candles"))

quotient_relation(at("haleigh.new_candles.five_ounce.count", "current"), at("haleigh.combined_wax", "current"), at("haleigh.new_candles.each.wax", "target"), source("How many 5 ounce candles can she make"))
query("value", at("haleigh.new_candles.five_ounce.count", "current"))
